hook.name: StashHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a flat 3% (300 bps) toll on the ETH leg of all four swap forms (exact-input and exact-output in both directions) in a single deployer-pinned pool, accumulating fees as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager. Anyone can call collect() to transfer the accumulated ETH fees to a fixed, immutable vault address set by the deployer.
